subject: Re: Ephemeral prompt-pack exchange and constrained usage timeline
messages:
From: Alicia Monroe <alicia.monroe@betaanalytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: dataops@betaanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exchange: prompt-pack + testcases for short evaluation window

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for a great demo yesterday. Beta Analytics is excited to run a short-form evaluation against Redwood to validate latency and quality tradeoffs for our ingestion pipeline. We propose a scoped exchange of materials (prompt pack + ~5k labelled testcases) under a Mutual Action Plan so both sides can move quickly.

High-level asks from our side:
- Ephemeral access to your evaluation sandbox (no more than 60 days).
- A token/key scoped to evaluation only (no training or external sharing).
- Usage cap: 5k inference calls during the evaluation; we'll share a sampling plan.
- Evidence that Redwood will purge KV/prefix caches and not retain any testcases beyond the retention period.

We're ready to sign a simple MAP and an evaluation addendum (we can share our standard form). Could Redwood share a proposed timeline and what you need from us to provision access (S3 link, sample metadata CSV, signoff owner)?

Attachments: brief list of the promptpack contents and a small sample of labels (zip).

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Monroe
Head of Data Science
Beta Analytics
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Monroe <alicia.monroe@betaanalytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exchange: prompt-pack + testcases for short evaluation window

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the clear outline. Redwood can support a constrained exchange; below is a concise MAP I propose so legal and engineering can act quickly: 

MAP (high level)
- Day 0: NDA/MAP countersigned (DocuSign link).
- Day 1: Beta uploads prompt-pack + metadata S3 link; Redwood validates schema and sets ephemeral sandbox.
- Day 2–14: Canary run (1000 sample cap) to calibrate prompts and sampling.
- Day 15–45: Full evaluation window (up to 5k calls).
- Day 46–60: Takedown + evidence (Redwood confirms deletion of datasets/caches and provides purge logs).

Minimum constraints we require:
- A usage-only license (no model training, no redistribution).
- Ephemeral keys expire automatically at end of agreed window.
- Restrict access to named Beta engineers listed in the MAP.

I'll attach a short internal runbook (MAP_steps_v3.pdf) that calls out the provisioning checklist and the purge evidence we can produce. For the token lifetime you suggested (60 days) — engineering prefers 30-days by default for automatic rotation, but we can make that configurable to 60 with an audit event on extension. Can you confirm whether Beta can accept a 30-day default that we extend to 60 on written request?

If that sounds good I'll loop in Legal for the quick DPA/MAP signoff and get an S3 staging location ready.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Principal Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Alicia Monroe <alicia.monroe@betaanalytics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exchange: prompt-pack + testcases for short evaluation window

Thanks — quick technical clarifications from infra before we finalize: 

1) Canary limits: we suggest 1k calls for the first 7 days rather than 14, then increase ramp if signal looks good. That reduces blast risk.
2) Sampling: provide a CSV with a sample_id, expected_label, and a short rationale column. We will run deterministic sampling to ensure reproducibility.
3) KMS / keys: keys will be customer-scoped; if Beta requires a KMS-backed key we need lead time to attach an external key. Otherwise we'll generate ephemeral keys that are single-use per evaluation and rotated on extension.

Attachments: sample-usage-contract.docx (short addendum we use for these swaps).

I'll be the point for the canary run. If Beta wants to push to 60 days upfront, we need an explicit signoff in the MAP (engineering is OK with the extension but wants it recorded).

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Partner Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Monroe <alicia.monroe@betaanalytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: dataops@betaanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exchange: prompt-pack + testcases for short evaluation window

Hi Tessa / Priyom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Beta is fine with the 1k canary for 7 days. On the token lifetime: our security team prefers a full 60-day window to run some downstream slice analyses; we'll sign the MAP if Redwood can commit to 60 days but with the understanding that Redwood will generate an audit event at day 30 (rotation checkpoint) and produce purge logs at takedown.

We can share the S3 link today (I attached the prompt-pack sample in my first email). Also, I'll route the MAP to our legal for countersign — I'll send a DocuSign once our counsel makes a minor CRO redline.

DocuSign (incoming): https://docusign.com/rdw/Envelope/A1B2C3-DocSig-MAP

Alicia
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Monroe <alicia.monroe@betaanalytics.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exchange: prompt-pack + testcases for short evaluation window

Appreciate the confirmation, Alicia. Redwood accepts the 60-day evaluation window on the condition you indicate (day-30 rotation checkpoint + purge evidence). We will record the extension in the MAP and add the named Beta engineers to the access list. Next steps: 

- Tessa: will send S3 staging credentials and an ephemeral key by EOD (scoped to Beta engineers).
- Priyom: will schedule a 30-minute kick-off to walk the canary plan (propose Wed Jun 17 at 10:00 PT).
- Beta: please complete the DocuSign counter and attach the sampled CSV (sample_id, expected_label, rationale).

Deliverables: beta_eval_promptpack_v1.zip (staging), MAP countersigned, purge audit report by Day 61.

I'll keep the MAP doc updated in the Drive link Tessa shared. Looking forward to the run.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference
